name: metabolic bone disease pathway
title: Metabolic bone disease pathway: the lab panel separates osteomalacia, Paget's disease and osteogenesis imperfecta; each column gives how it presents, the test, when to treat and the treatment

nodes.title: Lab panel first: calcium, phosphate, alkaline phosphatase (ALP)
lines: plus 25-hydroxyvitamin D (25-OH-D), parathyroid hormone, urine calcium
~separates all three before any imaging

nodes.title: Osteomalacia (adult) / rickets (child)
lines: ↓ 25-OH-D · ↑ parathyroid hormone · ↓ URINE calcium
~MINERALIZATION defect from vitamin D deficiency

nodes.title: Paget's disease of bone
lines: ↑ urinary hydroxyproline · 5% of people, 10% over 80
~disordered REMODELLING: ↑ resorption, then abnormal fragile new bone

nodes.title: Osteogenesis imperfecta
lines: diagnosis is CLINICAL
~TYPE I COLLAGEN defect: COL1A1 / COL1A2 in 85–90%

nodes.title: Presents as
lines: overt symptoms, unlike osteoporosis: bone and joint pain, fractures
PROXIMAL muscle weakness (myopathy) → falls
children: bowed legs, lordosis, large forehead

nodes.title: Presents as
lines: usually ASYMPTOMATIC: a routine x-ray or a raised ALP
bone pain (pelvis, femur, tibia) · bowed tibia, kyphosis, fractures
skull: headaches, bigger HAT SIZE, deafness · WARMTH over the bone

nodes.title: Presents as
lines: fragility fractures from minimal trauma, from in utero or birth
blue sclerae · hearing loss · dentinogenesis imperfecta · joint hypermobility
short stature, bowed long bones, scoliosis, Wormian bones

nodes.title: Investigations
lines: x-ray: pseudofractures (Looser zones)
biopsy is the gold standard but rarely needed

nodes.title: Investigations
lines: bone scan for extent · bones expanded and denser
x-ray: cotton wool skull · blade of grass · banana fracture · picture-frame vertebra

nodes.title: Investigations
lines: skeletal x-rays · the lab panel is normal

nodes.title: Causes — treat the underlying cause
lines: little sun or diet · malabsorption (celiac disease) · liver or kidney disease · anticonvulsants

nodes.title: Treat, even if asymptomatic, when
lines: active disease (↑ ALP or active scintigraphy) and any of:
skull, long bone, spine or joint-abutting disease · surgery planned at the site (vascular) · heart failure

nodes.title: Treat the bone disease when
lines: long bone deformity · vertebral compression fracture · more than 3 fractures a year

nodes.title: Treatment: vitamin D, plus calcium and phosphate if low
lines: 25-OH-D < 30 nmol/L: 50,000 IU weekly × 12 weeks, then 800–2,000 IU
30–75 nmol/L: 800–2,000 IU daily
recheck at 3 months, aiming for 75–150 nmol/L

nodes.title: Treatment
lines: bisphosphonates — intravenous zoledronate beats oral
calcitonin works only early · monitor with ALP
complications: fractures, deafness, cord compression, high-output heart failure
osteosarcoma in 1–3%: new pain, lytic lesion, rising ALP

nodes.title: Bone-forming agents are CONTRAINDICATED
lines: ~the disease is already abnormal formation

nodes.title: Treatment: intravenous bisphosphonates (zoledronate), the mainstay
lines: lifelong monitoring: hearing, spirometry, echocardiogram, bone density, spine x-rays
~type 1 a normal lifespan; type 2 lethal perinatally

edges.label: calcium, phosphate normal · ALP VERY HIGH
